patterns.message: Import design-system components from 'index.js', not component internals.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().

no-restricted-syntax.selector: Literal[value=/font-family\s*:\s*(?!['\"]?(?:Spectral|Source Sans 3|IBM Plex Mono|Noto Sans SC|Noto Serif SC|EB Garamond|Cinzel|Alegreya Sans SC))/i]
no-restricted-syntax.message: Font not provided by the design system. Available: Spectral, Source Sans 3, IBM Plex Mono, Noto Sans SC, Noto Serif SC, EB Garamond, Cinzel, Alegreya Sans SC.
<Badge> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: children, tone, variant, icon, mono, size, onRemove, style.
<Badge> tone must be one of 'neutral' | 'accent' | 'madder' | 'verdigris' | 'woad' | 'ochre'.
<Badge> variant must be one of 'soft' | 'solid' | 'outline'.
<Badge> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md'.
<Button> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, size, icon, iconRight, children, disabled, fullWidth, onClick, title, type, style.
<Button> variant must be one of 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'danger'.
<Button> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'.
<Button> type must be one of 'button' | 'submit'.

<CharacterCard> kind must be one of 'PC' | 'NPC' | 'MONSTER'.

<DiceButton> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: sides, onClick, size, title, style.
<DiceButton> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md'.
<EmptyState> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: icon, text, hint, action, compact, style.
<FloatingNoteCard> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, content, tone, minimized, width, height, onClose, onToggle, onToneChange, style.

<IconButton> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: icon, size, tone, active, disabled, onClick, title, shape, style.
<IconButton> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'.
<IconButton> tone must be one of 'muted' | 'accent' | 'danger'.
<IconButton> shape must be one of 'square' | 'circle'.
<InitiativeParticipant> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: id, name, kind, initiative.

<ItemRow> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: name, category, quantity, description, owner, actions, style.

<MapToken> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: kind, name, label, size, active, selected, conditions, dimmed, onClick, style.

<Modal> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: open, title, icon, onClose, footer, children, width, style.
<Panel> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, code, icon, meta, actions, footer, children, flush, tone, scroll, textured, brackets, style, bodyStyle.

<ResizeHandle> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: orientation, onMouseDown, title.

<RollResult> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: formula, total, detail, time, emphasis, style.
<SegmentItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: id, label, icon, count, title.
<SelectOption> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, label.
